comment: Release conditions for every exact-pinned version in package.json (dependencies, devDependencies and overrides),
plus any override added to clear an npm audit advisory. An exact pin is invisible to update-npm-deps.ps1 - that
script upgrades caret ranges and skips exact versions - so nothing would ever remind you a pin is stale. This file
is what makes that check happen: on every run the script executes each `check` and compares its trimmed stdout to
`expect`. Equal means the pin is still required; different means the condition that justified the pin has changed
and the pin should be re-examined. `check: null` means no mechanical test exists - it is reported for manual review
on every run instead of going quiet. Every exact pin must have an entry here, and every entry must name a package
that is actually present in the declared section; the script reports either mismatch. Same shape as

@codemirror/state.why: Must match Obsidian's exact peer dependency so consumers use one CodeMirror instance.

@codemirror/view.why: Must match Obsidian's exact peer dependency so consumers use one CodeMirror instance.

@lezer/common.why: Types must match the version bundled in Obsidian; see AGENTS.md for the distinguishing bundle markers. Re-checked against Obsidian 1.15.1 on 2026-11-26: its StructureCursor is still the 1.5.2 shape, while npm moved to 1.5.7.

@microsoft/eslint-plugin-sdl.why: A nested override, { "eslint-plugin-n": "^17.24.0" }, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for the minimatch 9 that eslint-plugin-n 17.10.3 brings under @microsoft/eslint-plugin-sdl (through eslint-plugin-obsidianmd). eslint-plugin-n 17.24.0 is the same major and depends on no minimatch at all.
@microsoft/eslint-plugin-sdl.manualCheck: Remove the override when @microsoft/eslint-plugin-sdl admits eslint-plugin-n >=17.22.0, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and npm run lint.

@puppeteer/browsers.why: Keep the integration tooling's browser downloader on the patched 3.x line.
@puppeteer/browsers.manualCheck: Re-evaluate the inherited override against npm audit and the browser downloader ranges in obsidian-integration-testing. Remove when all parents admit the patched version.

@stryker-mutator/core.why: A nested override, { "minimatch": "^11.0.5" }, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for @stryker-mutator/core alone, which declares minimatch ~10.2.4 and calls only minimatch() and new Minimatch().match(), which minimatch 11 keeps. Scoped rather than global because typedoc 0.28.20 calls Minimatch#set with matchOne, which minimatch 11 removed (T6738 tracks typedoc's own copy upstream, TypeStrong/typedoc#3151).
@stryker-mutator/core.manualCheck: Remove the override when @stryker-mutator/core admits minimatch >=11.0.1, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and npm run test:mutation on one module.

@ts-morph/common.why: A nested override, { "minimatch": "^11.0.5" }, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for @ts-morph/common 0.29 alone, which declares minimatch ^10.0.1 and calls only minimatch() / new Minimatch().match(), which minimatch 11 keeps (P21 note minimatch-11-scoped-override.md). Scoped rather than global because typedoc 0.28.20 calls Minimatch#set with matchOne, which minimatch 11 removed (T6738 tracks typedoc's own copy upstream, TypeStrong/typedoc#3151).
@ts-morph/common.manualCheck: Remove the override when @ts-morph/common admits minimatch >=11.0.1, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and npm run build.

deepmerge-ts.why: Keep the Webdriver integration tooling on the patched 8.x line.
deepmerge-ts.manualCheck: Re-evaluate the inherited override against npm audit and Webdriver's dependency ranges. Remove when all parents admit the patched version.

eslint-plugin-obsidianmd.why: Must be the copy @mnaoumov/obsidian-dev-toolkit brings (its dependency ^0.5.1), or ESLint aborts with ConfigError: Cannot redefine plugin "obsidianmd", because the shared config and this repo would register two copies. The sweep's ^0.6.0 did exactly that on 2026-11-26.
eslint-plugin-obsidianmd.manualCheck: When the toolkit takes 0.6, move to its range and run npm run lint.

eslint-plugin-tsdoc.why: A nested override, { "minimatch": "^11.0.5" }, clearing GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (minimatch >=7.0.0 <11.0.1) for the copy under eslint-plugin-tsdoc alone. eslint-plugin-tsdoc 0.5.4 pins @typescript-eslint/utils ~8.56.0, whose typescript-estree keeps minimatch 10 and calls only minimatch(filePath, pattern, { dot: true }), which minimatch 11 keeps. Scoped rather than global because typedoc 0.28.20 calls Minimatch#set with matchOne, which minimatch 11 removed (T6738 tracks typedoc's own copy upstream, TypeStrong/typedoc#3151).
eslint-plugin-tsdoc.manualCheck: Remove the override when eslint-plugin-tsdoc moves to a typescript-eslint that takes minimatch 11, then reinstall and rerun npm audit and npm run lint.

glob.why: Clears GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (AbortSignal cancellation bypass, glob >=9 <=14.0.1; patched 14.0.2). The latest obsidian-integration-testing 17.8.1 pins webdriverio 9.27.0, whose @wdio/config and archiver-utils still require glob ^10.2.2 and ^10.0.0. Both call only the retained sync API (sync/globSync), which glob 14 keeps along with its CommonJS build. No direct dependency update reaches the fix. Never use npm audit fix --force: it proposes downgrading the integration harness to 1.1.2.
glob.manualCheck: Remove the override when both consumers admit >=14.0.2. Re-run npm audit, the gate and the @wdio/config / archiver-utils glob smoke check.

js-yaml.why: The inherited exact override keeps YAML parsing on the existing pinned 4.3.2 release.
js-yaml.manualCheck: Compare upstream changes and npm audit before moving this inherited pin; remove it when parent ranges resolve safely without it.

katex.why: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 is fixed in 0.18.2; micromark-extension-math still requests the vulnerable ^0.16.0 line. Used by development markdown linting.

smol-toml.why: Keep transitive TOML parsers on a patched release; https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2 affects versions through 1.8.0.
smol-toml.manualCheck: Check all parent TOML parser ranges against npm audit; remove the override when every parent admits a patched release.

type-fest.why: obsidian-integration-testing 18.1.0 declares peer type-fest ^5.6.0, so the sweep's ^6.0.3 fails npm install with ERESOLVE. 5.10.0 is the last 5.x release, so the exact pin resolves exactly as ^5.10.0 would for consumers. T7002-P2 moves the harness to type-fest 6.
type-fest.manualCheck: When the harness peer admits type-fest 6, move this dependency to ^6 and run the gate, including tsc over the public declarations.

typescript.why: The compiler is deliberately held at the version this strict library toolchain builds and tests against.
typescript.manualCheck: Upgrade the compiler together with its tooling compatibility checks and run the complete branch gate.
